name: readable-docs
description: Review documents for readability and consistency — terms defined before use, no forward references, no gaps the reader has to fill in — and write texts from the user's materials without inventing a fact.

interface.longDescription: Review a document or a set of documents so that it reads as a coherent story: a structure proposal, role-based reviewer scores, concrete replacement wording and growth areas; the review reports and never edits the document. Write a text from the materials and answers the user gives, and nothing else: gaps become questions or open questions, every statement is traced to its source, and independent checks run before handover.
defaultPrompt: Review this document for readability before I share it.
Check whether this spec reads in order without guessing.
Write a spec from these notes without inventing anything.
